items.titolo: Former OpenAI safety employee says company’s safety culture is broken
items.descrizione: David Robinson argues that Silicon Valley lacks the wisdom on how to handle AI safely and urges the industry to seek outside experts to help build a culture that prioritizes it.

items.titolo: Microsoft’s new Copilot app puts everything in one place – but the price is ‘evolving’
items.descrizione: Microsoft says Copilot has gotten ‘actually really good.’ The new app has AI agents and can write code. So how much is all this going to cost?

items.titolo: Google AI data center project investigated after 420 football fields of Finnish forest demolished
items.descrizione: Google’s latest data center construction project in Finland is being investigated after the company representing the search giant reportedly cleared over 300 hectares of forest before obtaining a mandatory environmental

items.titolo: How I made a paid Mac app in 11 days with Caude – without writing a single line of code
items.descrizione: Claude helped me vibe-code a Mac app and pass Apple’s review in less than two weeks. Come with me on my journey from idea to purchasable App Store product.
